newsitem.title: UK: Johnson Matthey hits five-month high, some wary.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Matthey hits five-month high, some wary.

text.p: Shares in Johnson Matthey Plc edged up to a five-month high on Monday as further optimism blossomed from an analysts' trip to its U.S. operations last week, traders and analysts aid.

Shares were up 6.5p at 581p by 1349 GMT on volume of 299,000 shares, after reaching 587p. Prices have rallied 27 percent since mid-June when annual results came in at the top end of analysts' forecasts.
Adam Collins, engineering analyst at Merrill Lynch, said the company appeared to be making progress toward meeting its targets on providing Intel Corp with its semiconductor packages, he said.
The company's packaging materials are used to make microprocessors.
But Collins said he maintained a "neutral" rating on the stock.
"We basically feel that after the recent run it has had, we prefer the shares to consolidate for the moment, given there are significant production hurdles that need to be met," he said.
The company also refines and markets precious metals and rare materials and manufactures catalysts and pollution control systems.
